claim.claim-text: 1. A spray-dried solid dispersion of (S)-[2-chloro-4-fluoro-5-(7-morpholin-4-yl-quinazolin-4-yl)phenyl]-(6-methoxy-pyridazin-3-yl)methanol in a polymeric matrix comprising or consisting of hypromellose acetate succinate.
2. The solid dispersion according to claim 1, which is a solid solution.

3. The solid dispersion according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the concentration of (S)-[2-chloro-4-fluoro-5-(7-morpholin-4-yl-quinazolin-4-yl)phenyl]-(6-methoxy-pyridazin-3-yl)methanol in the polymeric matrix is in a range of between 4 and 50 weight percent, based upon the total weight of the solid dispersion.

4. The solid dispersion according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the concentration of (S)-[2-chloro-4-fluoro-5-(7-morpholin-4-ylquinazolin-4-yl)phenyl]-(6-methoxy-pyridazin-3-yl)methanol in the polymeric matrix is in a range of between 10 to 30 weight percent, based upon the total weight of the solid dispersion.
5. A pharmaceutical composition comprising the solid dispersion according to any of claims 1 to 4.
6. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 5, which is a pharmaceutical composition for oral administration.
7. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 6, which is an immediate release composition.
8. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 7, characterized by a disintegration time of 15 minutes or less.

9. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 5, which is a tablet comprising at least one pharmaceutically acceptable excipient selected from a filler, a disintegrant, a lubricant, a pore builder, and an inorganic alkaline metal salt.
10. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 5, which is a tablet comprising:
11. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 5, which is a tablet comprising:
12. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 5, which is a tablet comprising:

13. The pharmaceutical composition according to any of claims 9 to 12, wherein the filler is microcrystalline cellulose and/or the disintegrant is selected from crospovidone, carboxymethylcellulose and salts and derivatives thereof, and/or the inorganic alkaline metal salt is an inorganic sodium salt.
14. The pharmaceutical composition according to any of claims 5 to 13 for use in the treatment of cancer.
15. The pharmaceutical composition according to any of claims 5 to 13 for use in the treatment of cancer in combination with radiotherapy.
